direction: Calm, warm, confident educator. One continuous read, conversational pace (~150 wpm). Let sentences run into each other; small natural breaths, no robotic gaps. Slight lift on 'Now watch', settle down on the key line.

lines.text: The SA node fires, the signal travels down through the AV node, and both ventricles squeeze together.
Now watch what happens in third-degree heart block.
No signal gets from the atria down to the ventricles. The atria and ventricles each fire on their own clocks.
A slow backup pacemaker below the block keeps the heart going, often at only 20 to 40 beats a minute.
Put pacing pads on. If unstable, give atropine, but don't count on it. Pace, or start an epinephrine drip.
Practice it on ACLSMED Sim. ACLSmed dot com.
